title: TIFF node metadata
description: A TIFF or BigTIFF file (`node_type` file) or one of its images (`node_type` image, one Image File Directory) as JSON. Tags are named as in the TIFF 6.0 specification and its extensions; an unknown tag is named by its number. Long arrays such as tile offsets are summarised by their value count, because reading them is not needed to describe the image. GeoTIFF keys and GDAL metadata are decoded into `geo_keys` and `gdal_metadata` and documented by the GeoTIFF and GDAL convention schemas. Unofficial JSON Schema authored by hamk-uas/stac-schema-explorer to document and check metadata embedded in data files; it is not published or endorsed by the maintainers of the format or convention.
